title: Canonical open pro-etale pullback evaluation and its unit
statement:
Let $X,U$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, with constant ring sheaves $\Lambda_X,\Lambda_U$ on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Use the actual module inverse and direct images $j^*,j_*$ and unit $\eta_j$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], with the canonical coefficient identification of [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-exact]. Let $M$ be any sheaf of $\Lambda_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

There are isomorphisms
$$\rho_{M,W}:(j^*M)(W\to U)\xrightarrow{\sim}M(W\to U\to X)$$
for every pro-etale object $W\to U$, natural in $M$ and in $W$, and linear under the constant-coefficient restriction identification in [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization]. Under these isomorphisms, the component of the specified adjunction unit at every pro-etale $V\to X$ is exactly restriction:
$$\rho_{M,V\times_XU}\circ\eta_{j,M}(V)=\operatorname{res}_{V\times_XU/V}:M(V)\longrightarrow M(V\times_XU).$$
Here the codomain of $\eta_{j,M}(V)$ is $(j_*j^*M)(V)=(j^*M)(V\times_XU)$ by the direct-image formula [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], and the fibre product is that of [def-pc-fibre-product]. The isomorphisms refer to the actual inverse image constructed on compatible small skeletons as in [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. No quasi-compactness or constructibility hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 09BN, lemma-open-immersion, via localization of the open site; canonical inverse-image evaluation and unit normalization made explicit from the construction in def-weil-proetale-inverse-image.

proof.text: Let v be composition with j and u be base change. Their existing mapPullbackAdj adjunction has counit the specified first projection. The functor v is continuous and cocontinuous for the pro-etale topologies. Apply Functor.pushforwardContinuousSheafificationCompatibility to the constant commutative ring presheaf, giving d from the constant ring on U to literal restriction of the constant ring on X. Its toSheafify_pullbackSheafificationCompatibility identity proves the required normalization on every constant section.

The coefficient map used by the published module direct image is the adjunct of c. By the inverse-image definition c is itself the adjunct of the constant-section direct-image map. The Hom equivalence inverse law therefore identifies the two direct-image coefficient maps. Precompose each of the two ring compatibility identities for mapPullbackAdj with the constant-presheaf sheafification unit. The normalization of d and of the coefficient direct-image map reduces both identities to naturality of that unit. The sheafification universal property proves the original identities; forgetting commutativity preserves them.

Apply Mathlib SheafOfModules.pushforwardPushforwardAdj to mapPullbackAdj and these two ring identities. Its left functor is literal restriction with scalars transported by d; its right functor is definitionally the published proEtaleConstantRingPushforward. Compare this adjunction with the published proEtaleConstantRingAdjunction by Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq. This produces a natural isomorphism from the actual small-model-and-tensor pullback to restriction, without replacing the actual functor or choosing any new module data.

Evaluate this natural isomorphism and its inverse at W to obtain rho as an additive equivalence. Linearity of its component gives the scalar formula under d, presheaf naturality gives naturality in W, and naturality of the functor isomorphism gives naturality in M. Finally Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app identifies the actual unit followed by rho with the restriction-adjunction unit. Mathlib pushforwardPushforwardAdj_unit_app_val_app identifies that unit with restriction along the counit of mapPullbackAdj, exactly proEtaleOpenSectionProjection.
